CHAPTER 5 · ITEM 06 / 11

Demand elasticity

Fixed quantity or spending固定數量或支出

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Interpret zero and unit elasticity in verbal situations, including fixed quantity purchased and fixed expenditure.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

每次購買固定數量代表零彈性；每次固定支出時 Q=k/P，代表單位彈性。須看價格改變時的購買規則。

A buyer who always buys the same quantity has zero price elasticity. A buyer who always spends the same amount has Q=k/P, giving unit elasticity. These are statements about behavior across prices.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：“Five liters regardless of price” means Ed=0. “$20 of fuel regardless of price” means Ed=1. 固定公升與固定金額不同。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

A buyer always buys $30 of rice. Price elasticity? 每次買三十元米？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
